final: WITH station_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), overall AS (SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS total_count FROM station_counts), ratios AS (SELECT station_counts.observstation, station_counts.telescope_count, 1.0 * station_counts.telescope_count / overall.total_count AS ratio FROM station_counts CROSS JOIN overall), avg_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM ratios) SELECT ratios.observstation, ratios.telescope_count, ratios.ratio, ratios.ratio - avg_ratio.mean_ratio AS deviation FROM ratios CROSS JOIN avg_ratio ORDER BY deviation DESC LIMIT 10
